title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Service-Con-201 exam
question:
Cloud Kicks support agents are getting too many emails due to case ownership changes.
What should the admin recommend to solve the issue?
option_A: Create a screen flow to change the case owner and bypass the new ownership email.
option_B: Uncheck the "Notify Case Owners when Case Ownership Changes" checkbox in Support Settings.
option_C: Instruct users to uncheck the "Send notification email" checkbox when changing the owner.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Service-Con-201 exam
question: The support manager at Universal Containers is getting inaccurate support rep performance reports. After researching the data, the Salesforce admin has identified hundreds of cases that are closed but still owned by a queue.

option_C: Create a case assignment rule to ensure cases are owned by a user when closed.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Service-Con-201 exam
question:

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Service-Con-201 exam
question:
